description: Construction number 96A1906; the tactical number 1906 derives from it. Transferred from Politechnika Koszalińska to the Rosnowo veterans' organisation under a 2006 resolution; renovated 2008 and unveiled 28 August 2010 on a 4.5-tonne plinth made by Andrzej Popowicz of Koszalin. Repainted August 2021. Commemorates 26. PLM and 9. PLM Zegrze Pomorskie 1952-2002
